note: Public Swiss targets for core.bench.score (#42). status: verified = already checked by the team (same source as the assumption file); to_verify = figure known but not yet checked against the primary source tonight; to_fill = source known, figure must be read from it (e.g. a calculator). Only verified targets count in score() by default. kind: assumption = compares an assumption value; tax_rate_at = effective rate of the tax table at an income; not_modelled = a Swiss rule the engine does not model yet (see core/ENGINE_AUDIT.md).
